runtime_smoke.note: App Lock is disabled for guest session (no PIN configured), so live unlock->remount->relock cannot be exercised in web preview. The module-flag design is correct: SESSION_UNLOCKED persists across React component remounts because it lives in module scope.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix design is sound: SESSION_UNLOCKED is at module scope (line 37), so it survives AppLockGate unmount/remount triggered by Stack navigator reconciliation. Reset only occurs on real background-return past LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS (15s), which matches the stated intent.

Note (informational, not blocking): SESSION_UNLOCKED is process-scoped, so a fresh JS bundle reload (e.g. Metro fast-refresh in dev) will reset it — expected. In prod this is fine; the AppState listener drives the security-relevant reset.

Note: commitUnlock also does bioBusyRef.current = false and autoTriggeredRef.current = false BEFORE setLocked(false); if the lock screen unmounts (locked -> false), the auto-trigger effect cleanup handles the timer — no stale prompt risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AppLockGate.tsx SESSION_UNLOCKED fix is verified statically and via smoke test. Full end-to-end unlock->remount->no-relock behavior requires a device/emulator with App Lock + PIN set (cannot exercise on web preview because expo-local-authentication isn't available in browser). For any future device testing: enable App Lock in Settings, set a PIN, force-lock, then unlock via PIN — watch adb logcat for the ordered sequence: 'UNLOCK NOW' -> 'render: locked= false' -> (any subsequent) 'maybeLock() called' should be immediately followed by 'SESSION_UNLOCKED true — already unlocked this session, skipping', with NO 'setLocked(true)' occurring after unlock.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (from user's adb logcat): after commitUnlock succeeded (setLocked(false)), the Stack navigator re-reconciled and AppLockGate remounted ~70ms later. The mount useEffect on the new instance re-ran maybeLock(), which then re-called setLocked(true), re-locking the app. Root cause was that lock state lived only in React component state, which is discarded on unmount. Fix: a module-scope boolean SESSION_UNLOCKED that persists across remounts. maybeLock checks it first and short-circuits. The AppState listener resets it only when the app has actually been backgrounded >= 15s, preserving the security intent. Verified: flag declared at module top, set inside commitUnlock, guarded in maybeLock before any other check, reset inside AppState's active-return branch only when elapsed >= LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS.
